Baptised at Broadwindsor, Dorset, in July 1601, son of George Hutchins.
He is on the Protestation Return of 1641, the oath to defend the Protestant religion that every grown man in England
was asked to take on the eve of the Civil War.
Buried at Broadwindsor on 13 December 1684 as "Mathew Hutchins, Elder".
Wife of Mathew Hutchins the elder of Broadwindsor: the baptism of their daughter Johanna in 1634 names her mother
